method.source_scope: Git tracked and nonignored files in openhab,src,scripts,deploy,tests,.github,public; UTF-8 regular nonsymlink files <=4MiB; binary extensions excluded. Provider-name variants plus live/file-linked Items and literal forecast-worker publication names. Line references contain identifiers only.
method.root_overlay_scope: Same scan of current /home/sat/earthship-ui, retaining only matching files whose bytes differ from the isolated branch. Uncommitted overlays are observed source, not part of source_revision.
method.state_scope: Literal DEFAULT_STATE keys and literal state/st/loaded/defaults get,setdefault,pop and subscript keys in forecast_intel.py. Dynamic and other-module learned-state keys need semantic review.
method.live_scope: Authenticated read-only local OpenHAB registry; standard installed file paths and selected loaded user unit states. No environment values, Item states, rule bodies or credential bytes are retained.
limitations: Text matches identify candidates; absence does not prove all transitive dependencies removed.
OpenHAB add-on catalog omitted this custom binding; actual add-on JAR is inventoried separately.
Live rule code, bundle activation, other-module dynamic state and every installed override still require attended cutover verification.
